entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.3489 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Bhadrak arising out of Bonth P.S. Case No.171 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Section 420 IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners undertakes to implead Informant as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title be filed by 16.05.2025.
Requisites for issuance of notice to the said Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post with A.D shall also be filed by the said date peremptorily.
4. Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain the case diary by the next date.
As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
7. It is needless to state that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
